title: A bosonic temporal field quantizes, and Standard Model data stay open

statements.text: A shift-symmetric temporal potential with a positive hyperbolic quadratic action quantizes canonically into a controlled bosonic field. Gauge fields, fermions and mass are kept behind the gates they require, and the Standard Model representations and Yukawa data remain open.
statements.conditions: graded by the author as open beyond the bosonic branch

sources.quote: canonical quantisation gives a controlled bosonic field.
Standard Model representations and Yukawa data remain open.
